expectation: Membranous (cell-border ring) at epithelial adherens junctions, co-localising with E-cadherin; common in this gut epithelium, lining crypts and glands as honeycomb rings. Stroma, lumen and muscle should be mostly negative; some nuclear signal in Wnt-active cells.
observed: A: stain is confined to the epithelium of folded mucosa, with dark lumen and stroma. B/C: crisp membrane rings and palisading columnar cells lining crypts, with a honeycomb in en-face cuts. D: sharp junctional lines between neighbouring cells. E: bCAT rings sit on E-cadherin-positive cells and stroma is clear.
why: Crisp membranous junctional staining restricted to epithelium, tracing crypt architecture and co-localising with E-cadherin, as a working bCAT stain should.
